summary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The 0444 subject is at the dispatched digest 1021ab2b... before and after the pass. All 13 Measured inputs were recomputed from live bytes with zero mismatches and zero missing files; the pinned COORD digest, file 08 digest and HEAD equal live values, and the two Stage A verdict digests in the reviewer table match their Measured inputs counterparts. Live custody holds and was derived independently rather than accepted: last heading D-266 (ADOPTED at 96b5249e), no D-267 heading yet, 32 gate rows DR-G01..DR-G32 with 4 dropped/inapplicable giving required-now 28, owners 32 of 32, last gate row DR-G32, DR-125 status column exactly OPEN, file 08 and COORD clean. All 34 attacks were refuted — 21 from the dispatch list and 13 independent. The draft keeps leftover-join.v5 current at draft time with the successor qualifier on every not-current statement (founded: D-184 is the only DR-125 leftover recording), cites occupancy v2 as current and v1 as predecessor (founded: no v3 exists), recites leftoverDesign as [OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED] matching v6's summary exactly, claims no closure anywhere, keeps naming parentage at naming v6 (D-145) and D-086 rather than at the leftover lineage (founded: DR-G20 occurs in naming.v3), and disposes both prior findings as landed at v5 without re-landing them, matching v6's findingDisposition verbatim. The observation asymmetry is handled correctly: CLAUDE-SDKLJ-V6-O1 is named and characterized as a named observation with no observationsNotFindings and no advisories field, the empty Codex return is recited as 'none' without minting an identifier, and the draft explicitly disclaims that both reviewers' identifiers are preserved. The no-cell-edit branch runs D-170 through D-235 and D-237 through D-266 — 30 consecutive members with no gap or duplicate — and does not span D-236, correctly, since live D-236 records DR-104 SATISFIED under D-056 Class B. One non-blocking stylistic observation is recorded.
